settings.heading: The Genesis
settings.paragraph_1: Veloura was born at the intersection of rigorous clinical dermatology and high-performance textile engineering. We observed a fundamental flaw in the traditional approach to cellulite and skin texture: the industry treated it as a purely aesthetic fat issue, masking it rather than addressing the physiological root cause.
settings.paragraph_2: Through years of research, we isolated the true mechanism — stagnant microcirculation and lymphatic fluid. This realisation catalysed the development of our proprietary Velo-Lymph™ technology, shifting the paradigm from passive shapewear to active, therapeutic apparel.

settings.title: Not a Fat Issue
settings.body: Dermatologists have established that cellulite is fundamentally a circulation problem — a localised lymphatic drainage failure rather than excess lipid storage.

settings.title: The Flaw in Compression
settings.body: Traditional shapewear merely compresses superficially, masking the texture while often exacerbating the underlying circulatory stagnation by restricting blood flow.

settings.title: Active Stimulation
settings.body: We engineered garments that work dynamically with your body's movement, providing continuous micro-massage to stimulate lymphatic flow for the hours you wear them.

settings.heading: The Science of Stimulation
settings.body: Our proprietary fabric maps over 47+ micro-pressure points directly into the textile structure. Each point is meticulously calculated to trigger a specific lymphatic pathway with every step you take.

settings.quote: We didn't set out to make another legging. We set out to engineer a solution that respects the biological reality of women's bodies. Veloura is where scientific rigour meets daily wear.
